summary: query/q is shorthand for lookup(..., wantlist=True); lists of lookup plugins can be found with ansible-doc -l -t lookup.
questions: What's the difference between lookup and query?
How do I list available lookup plugins?

answer_card.title: query / q
answer_card.answer_md:
`q('ns.col.lookup_items')` is the same as `lookup('ns.col.lookup_items', wantlist=True)`, so it always returns a list. List installed lookups with:

```bash
ansible-doc -l -t lookup
```
